title: Pyomelanin-powered whole-cell biosensor for ultrasensitive and selective detection of bioavailable Hg(II)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30456-30465
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05253J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiangpeng Tang, Chang-ye Hui, Shunyu Hu, Wanyan Wu, Peishuo Cao, Jingwen Ling, Xueqin Yang, Zhenlie Huang, Yan Guo
We developed a pyomelanin-powered biosensor for ultrasensitive Hg(II) detection in water. It achieves a 1.2 nM detection limit, works in tap, lake, and seawater without extraction, and offers a robust alternative to traditional methods.
